thread.title: Thai Stock Market May See Additional Support

author: RTTNews
title: Thai Stock Market May See Additional Support
text:
(RTTNews) - The Thai stock market bounced higher again on Wednesday, one session after it had halted the nine-day winning streak in which it had jumped more than 45 points or 2.8 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now rests just above the 1,630-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Thursday.
The global forecast for the Asian markets is broadly positive on an improved outlook for interest rates and a spike in crude oil prices. The European and U.S. markets were up and the Asian bourses are predicted to follow suit.
The SET finished modestly higher on Wednesday as gained from the cement and energy companies were capped by weakness from the financial sector.
For the day, the index advanced 8.55 points or 0.53 percent to finish at 1,632.60 after trading between 1,622.59 and 1,632.83. Volume was 11.903 billion shares worth 48.709 billion baht. There were 761 gainers and 519 decliners, with 508 stocks finishing unchanged.
Among the actives, Advanced Info shed 0.28 percent, while Thailand Airport jumped 1.45 percent, Bangkok Bank lost 0.47 percent, Bangkok Medical skidded 1.24 percent, Bangkok Expressway advanced 0.95 percent, Charoen Pokphand Foods slid 0.91 percent, Kasikornbank dipped 0.26 percent, PTT Exploration and Production spiked 2.11 percent, PTT Global Chemical added 0.75 percent, Siam Commercial Bank collected 0.77 percent, Siam Concrete gained 0.43 percent and PTT, Banpu and Krung Thai Bank were unchanged.
The lead from Wall Street is firm in response to the Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement, which sent the major averages to nearly two-month closing highs.
The Dow added 434.90 points or 1.77 percent to 25,014.86, while the NASDAQ surged 154.79 points or 2.20 percent to 7,183.08 and the S&P 500 rose 41.05 points or 1.55 percent to 2,681.05.
Stocks accelerated to the upside after the Fed announced its widely expected decision to leave interest rates unchanged and indicated it will remain patient regarding further rate hikes.
Positive sentiment was also generated by solid earnings news from companies like Boeing (BA) and Apple (AAPL).
Crude oil prices surged Wednesday, extending gains from the previous session on U.S. sanctions of Venezuelan oil. West Texas Intermediate Crude oil futures for March ended up $0.92 or 1.7 percent at $54.23 a barrel.
Closer to home, Thailand will provide December numbers for imports, exports and trade balance later today. In November, imports were worth $20.65 billion and exports were at $21.32 billion for a trade surplus of $0.66 billion.
